inputs.name: NativeAuthService.constructor.options
inputs.description: The AuthOptions object the constructor stores as this.options; origin, http, store and open are required, and now, clearCache and onDisconnect are optional. origin is the expected origin of handoff verification URLs and of the stored credential, and now (used for handoff expiry and poll timing) defaults to Date.now() when omitted.

inputs.name: NativeAuthService.deviceApproval.action
inputs.description: Validated review action for the currently admitted Mac device.

outputs.name: NativeAuthService.connect
outputs.description: The pending status that connect() resolves with once the handoff has started: configured is true, state is 'pending', and handoff holds userCode (at most 40 characters), verificationUrl, expiresAt and interval (seconds, 1 to 30), with the internal handoffId removed. The verification URL is passed to options.open before the promise resolves, and connect() never resolves with a signed-in status.

outputs.name: NativeAuthService.status
outputs.description: While a handoff is pending, status() resolves signed-out once it has expired, returns the cached pending status until the next poll is due, and resolves signed-in with the actor once an approved handoff is exchanged and its credential is saved. With no pending handoff and no stored credential it resolves signed-out, with configured true only when the public status (http.publicStatus) says configured: true; with a stored credential it resolves with the NativeAccountStatusService reading of that credential. The packaged Mac also verifies device admission before returning signed-in and before it enables project or approval actions.

outputs.name: NativeAuthService.disconnect
outputs.description: Resolves with { configured: true, state: 'signed-out' } after onDisconnect runs, the pending handoff is dropped, and a logout request is sent when a credential is stored. In a finally block the store is cleared and clearCache (when provided) runs, so both still run if the logout request rejects, and that rejection then reaches the caller instead of a resolved status.

errors.name: NativeSignInError
errors.description: NativeSignInError objects thrown by this unit: connect() rejects with 'OS encryption is required for hosted sessions.' when store.available() is false, and status() rejects with 'Native handoff expired or was refused.' when the polled handoff answers with a status other than 'pending' or 'approved'. Failures from the HTTP adapter, the session store, the validators and the open callback are not caught here and reach the caller unchanged.
